items.prompt:
The interior angles of a triangle sum to:
A) $90°$
B) $180°$
C) $270°$
D) $360°$

A triangle has angles $40°$ and $80°$. The third is:
A) $40°$
B) $60°$
C) $80°$
D) $100°$

In an isosceles triangle, the base angles are:
A) Supplementary
B) Equal
C) Right angles
D) Different

An isosceles triangle has a vertex angle of $50°$. Each base angle is:
A) $50°$
B) $65°$
C) $80°$
D) $130°$

A midsegment of a triangle is:
A) Equal to the third side
B) Half the third side and parallel to it
C) Twice the third side
D) Perpendicular to the third side
items.answer: B) Half the third side and parallel to it

steps: Midsegment = half the third side, parallel to it.
